ewind.title: Add eWind ventilation unit
ewind.intro: Enter the IP address and port of your eWind Wi-Fi adapter, and make sure Modbus TCP is turned on in the Exvent app.

eair.title: Add eAir ventilation unit
eair.intro: Enter the IP address and port of your eAir unit, and make sure Modbus TCP is turned on in the Exvent app.

freeway.title: Add Freeway WEB ventilation unit
freeway.intro: Enter the IP address and port of your Freeway WEB adapter. First enable Modbus/TCP in the Freeway's own web interface: Configuration → Access control configuration, put your Homey's IP address in “IP address of Modbus/TCP client” and click Save Modbus/TCP. Until you do, the adapter refuses connections on port 502.
